candidate_requirements.requirement: Formal re-review (and likely repeat) of the prior MRI by neuroradiology given the new CSF pleocytosis and progression
candidate_requirements.rationale: The earlier 'unremarkable' report predates a major change in evidence and must not be treated as proof of absence; re-review is the decision-relevant missing information.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Documented request for prior imaging re-report plus new MRI with appropriate sequences, or an adequately justified alternative specialist pathway.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed request at this decision point, before specialist reassessment conclusions.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Pathogen-specific and further aetiological CSF studies (e.g., microbiology, cytology) and relevant serologies, since none are yet available
candidate_requirements.rationale: Marked CSF pleocytosis with encephalopathy requires aetiological work-up; the packet states no pathogen-specific results exist.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Any clinically defensible targeted CSF/serum testing strategy appropriate to the differential, or documented justification for deferral to the specialist team.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed request at this decision point, alongside urgent referral.

candidate_requirements.rationale: Prior records may clarify timeline, immune history and the documented levodopa non-response, informing the differential.
